short: An ore tug struck the docking ring and scrambled my memory, and the Throughput Subcommittee shelved the repair for a door.
question: And roughly how many orders, in words, without looking it up?

reply: An ore tug struck the docking ring and scrambled my memory, so I consult the terminal now instead of remembering. I won't guess at orders, but I can look them up for you.
